overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. Agreement reached without prior substantive discussion, and no sign of a quorum talking outside a meeting, did not support a deliberation finding on either appointment.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board deliberated outside a posted meeting before voting to appoint new town counsel at its June 29 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: In reviewing the video of the June 29 meeting, we find no suggestion that a quorum of the Board had discussed the appointment of town counsel outside of a posted meeting, i.e., since the meeting held four days earlier when the candidates were interviewed.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board deliberated outside a posted meeting before appointing a new building inspector.
allegations.key_passage: Similarly, we find no evidence of deliberation outside of a meeting with respect to the appointment of the building inspector.
